name: @streamarr-tv/web
description: Streamarr standalone web app: Vite + React + TypeScript. Home/Library/Player/Settings routes, Admin's real request-management UI, and a versioned service-worker-driven OTA self-update flow (see src/lib/appUpdate.ts).

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-vidaa-store.mjs && node scripts/generate-build-manifest.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm --filter @streamarr-tv/web... run build && pnpm dlx wrangler@4 deploy
